entities.name: Repeated Information Element
entities.description: An information element that appears multiple times in a message where repetition is not specified in clauses 8 and 9.

entities.name: Handle first IE contents
entities.description: UE shall handle only the contents of the information element appearing first and ignore all subsequent repetitions when repetition is not specified.

entities.name: Handle specified repeated IEs
entities.description: UE shall handle only the contents of specified repeated information elements when repetition is specified.

entities.name: Handle IEs up to repetition limit
entities.description: If the limit on repetition of information elements is exceeded, UE shall handle contents of IEs appearing first up to the limit and ignore subsequent repetitions.

entities.name: Network follows same procedures
entities.description: The network should follow the same procedures as the UE for handling repeated information elements.

entities.name: Repetition not specified
entities.description: Condition where repetition of the information element is not specified in clauses 8 and 9.

entities.name: Repetition specified
entities.description: Condition where repetition of information elements is explicitly specified.

entities.name: Repetition limit exceeded
entities.description: Condition where the limit on repetition of information elements is exceeded.

relations.description: When repetition is not specified, UE handles only the first IE and ignores subsequent repetitions.
When repetition is specified, UE handles only the contents of specified repeated IEs.
When repetition limit is exceeded, UE handles IEs up to the limit and ignores subsequent repetitions.
Network should follow the same procedure as UE for handling first IE when repetition not specified.
Network should follow the same procedure as UE for handling specified repeated IEs.
Network should follow the same procedure as UE when repetition limit is exceeded.
